name: chemsidekick
title: ChemSidekick
description: Small chemistry tools, fast: elements, unit conversions, XYZ structures, stereoisomers, energy profiles.

commands.name: chemsidekick
commands.title: ChemSidekick
commands.description: All ChemSidekick tools: pick one, fill in its form, see the result.

commands.name: element
commands.title: Element
commands.subtitle: ChemSidekick
commands.description: Find an element by symbol, name, or atomic number; its card and the periodic table.

commands.name: units
commands.title: Convert Units
commands.subtitle: ChemSidekick
commands.description: Chemistry unit conversions as you type: kcal/mol, eV, hartree, cm⁻¹, nm, debye, rate constants, pressure, charge.

commands.name: profile
commands.title: Energy Profile
commands.subtitle: ChemSidekick
commands.description: Energy profile A → TS → products: rate constants, half-lives, kinetic and equilibrium ratios; or Boltzmann populations.

commands.name: xyz
commands.title: XYZ Viewer
commands.subtitle: ChemSidekick
commands.description: Paste XYZ coordinates: formula, molecular weight, closest atoms, and 2D and 3D views.

preferences.name: autoOpen3D
preferences.title: 3D Viewer
preferences.label: Open the 3D viewer in the browser with the result
preferences.description: Open the interactive 3D viewer as soon as the result is ready.

commands.name: stereo
commands.title: Stereoisomers
commands.subtitle: ChemSidekick
commands.description: Every stereoisomer of a SMILES: R/S and E/Z labels, relations, 2D drawings, and a rotating 3D view.

preferences.name: cskPath
preferences.title: csk Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the csk executable. Leave empty to use ~/.local/bin/csk.

scripts.check: eslint src test && prettier --check src test && tsc --noEmit
